name: The Ritz-Carlton Reynolds, Lake Oconee
positioning: Lakeside resort on Lake Oconee in Greensboro, Georgia, with a Lake House, Fireside rooms, five championship golf courses and a 27,000-square-foot spa
best_for: Golfers who want five championship courses and club fitting at the resort
Groups wanting a Lake House or cottage stay with a dedicated concierge

facts.text: The resort is at 1 Lake Oconee Trail in Greensboro, Georgia.
Fireside Rooms and Suites have a private patio with a fire pit overlooking Lake Oconee.
The Lake House is a three-story, four-bedroom lakefront residence.
Lake House and Cottage guests have a dedicated Cottage Concierge to curate their stay.
Linger Longer Steakhouse has a lake house setting with views of the Georgia pines and the Oconee Course.
Amore del Lago is an Italian restaurant serving homemade pastas and wood-fired pizzas.
Gaby's by the Lake serves lobster grilled cheese, BBQ pork nachos and seasonal salads beside the Infinity Pool.
The spa is 27,000 square feet and includes a salon and nail area.
Four architects (Rees Jones, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Fazio and Bob Cupp) designed the resort's five championship golf courses.
The Kingdom at Reynolds Lake Oconee offers TaylorMade custom club fittings, private instruction and same-day club building on-site.
The land the resort sits on was once the family hunting retreat of Mercer Reynolds Sr.
Ritz Kids is designed for children aged five to 12 and covers tent-building and fishing techniques.

highlights.text: The land the resort sits on was once the family hunting retreat of Mercer Reynolds Sr.
The Linger Longer Express is a complimentary ten-minute ride around the resort on an eco-efficient locomotive.
The Falconry Encounter offers hands-on interaction with birds of prey guided by expert handlers.
Oconee Cove is a speakeasy lounge tucked away off the resort lobby.

considerations.text: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is the closest airport, listed at about 75 miles from the hotel.
The resort is exclusively cashless; guests must present a credit card at check-in.
The Infinity Pool is for guests ages 12 and older from May 21 through Labor Day Weekend and open to all guests the rest of the year.
